project_name: Karlawinda Gold Project gas power station
selection_note: Hindsight-selected development case (not a sealed holdout). On-ASX trail from a feasibility study that explicitly assumed an Independent Power Producer gas station (Oct 2017) to the executed power supply agreement with Contract Power Australia (announced Jun 2020). Contract Power is also the contractor named in the unverified MinRes Wodgina lead, so this is a second Contract Power data point.

lead_time.note: Target (ASX 23/06/2020 08:22 +10:00) minus the feasibility-study release (s1/s2, ASX 23/10/2017 11:06 +11:00). The FS only ASSUMED an IPP gas station via an LTPPA; it is a planning assumption, not a solicitation. No power tender, EOI or LOI was captured between the FS and the executed agreement. The agreement was 'recently executed' before the 2020 announcement, so the true gap to the procurement is shorter than computed. Both timestamps are ASX listing times read by the agent and not captured.
